# Unreal Engine 5.8 绑定与动画工具知识图谱

## 总览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    UE58["Unreal Engine 5.8"] --> Gizmos["Gizmos（显式空间、父空间、万向节）"]
    UE58 --> AutoBake["自动烘焙"]
    UE58 --> Physics["物理层（碰撞、重力、轨迹）"]
    UE58 --> Modular["模块化控制器"]
    UE58 --> DataFlow["数据流工具（网格转移）"]
    UE58 --> UI["UI 与快捷键改进"]
    Gizmos --> UI
    AutoBake --> UI
    Physics --> UI
    Modular --> UI
    Physics --> ForceField["力场"]
    ForceField --> ConvexHole["凸孔（精准碰撞）"]
    ConvexHole --> Physics
    Modular --> DirectMesh["直接网格控制 (DMC)"]
    DirectMesh --> WeightPaint["权重绘制 & 遮罩"]
    DataFlow --> Transfer["绑定/网格转移"]
    Transfer --> Modular
```

## 自动烘焙工作流
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    SelChar["选择角色"] --> AddAuto["右键 → 添加自动烘焙"]
    AddAuto --> Scan["系统扫描可烘焙组件"]
    Scan --> Options["设置导出选项（文件名、路径）"]
    Options --> Bake["生成烘焙版本"]
    Bake --> Icon["在对象旁显示烘焙图标"]
    Icon --> Toggle["图标切换 实时骨骼 ↔ 烘焙动画"]
    Toggle --> HotkeyAll["快捷键切换全部角色状态"]
    HotkeyAll --> EditRT["编辑实时骨骼时自动切回实时"]
    EditRT --> ReBake["动画更新 → 重新烘焙"]
```

## 物理层与动态效果
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Fizzy["Fizz Cube 骨架"] --> PhysLayer["物理层（碰撞、重力）"]
    PhysLayer --> Collision["世界碰撞"]
    PhysLayer --> Trajectory["运动轨迹"]
    Fizzy --> AutoBake
    AutoBake --> PhysLayer
    PhysLayer --> ForceField["力场（推动、下落）"]
    ForceField --> ConvexHole["凸孔（精准碰撞）"]
    ConvexHole --> PhysLayer
    PhysLayer --> RealTime["实时播放（无需Pi）"]
    RealTime --> Bake["可烘焙至动画序列"]
```

## 模块化控制器与直接网格控制
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    ModCtrl["模块化控制器系统"] --> EmptySlot["显示空插槽提示"]
    EmptySlot --> HideResolved["隐藏已解决插槽"]
    ModCtrl --> ShiftB["Shift + B 切换骨骼可见性"]
    ModCtrl --> DirectMesh["直接网格控制 (DMC)"]
    DirectMesh --> WeightPaint["权重绘制 & 遮罩"]
    WeightPaint --> SoftSelect["软选择功能"]
    DirectMesh --> MultiPoly["多层多边形组（FK/IK 切换）"]
    MultiPoly --> HierBinding["层级绑定（分层控制）"]
    HierBinding --> UI["UI 快捷键与快速菜单"]
    UI --> ShiftB
```

# Unreal Engine 5.8 绑定与动画工具知识图谱

## 总览
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    UE58["Unreal Engine 5.8"] --> Gizmos["Gizmos（显式空间、父空间、万向节）"]
    UE58 --> AutoBake["自动烘焙"]
    UE58 --> Physics["物理层（碰撞、重力、轨迹）"]
    UE58 --> Modular["模块化控制器"]
    UE58 --> DataFlow["数据流工具（网格转移）"]
    UE58 --> UI["UI 与快捷键改进"]
    Gizmos --> UI
    AutoBake --> UI
    Physics --> UI
    Modular --> UI
    Physics --> ForceField["力场"]
    ForceField --> ConvexHole["凸孔（精准碰撞）"]
    ConvexHole --> Physics
    Modular --> DirectMesh["直接网格控制 (DMC)"]
    DirectMesh --> WeightPaint["权重绘制 & 遮罩"]
    DataFlow --> Transfer["绑定/网格转移"]
    Transfer --> Modular
```

## 自动烘焙工作流
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    SelChar["选择角色"] --> AddAuto["右键 → 添加自动烘焙"]
    AddAuto --> Scan["系统扫描可烘焙组件"]
    Scan --> Options["设置导出选项（文件名、路径）"]
    Options --> Bake["生成烘焙版本"]
    Bake --> Icon["在对象旁显示烘焙图标"]
    Icon --> Toggle["图标切换 实时骨骼 ↔ 烘焙动画"]
    Toggle --> HotkeyAll["快捷键切换全部角色状态"]
    HotkeyAll --> EditRT["编辑实时骨骼时自动切回实时"]
    EditRT --> ReBake["动画更新 → 重新烘焙"]
```

## 物理层与动态效果
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Fizzy["Fizz Cube 骨架"] --> PhysLayer["物理层（碰撞、重力）"]
    PhysLayer --> Collision["世界碰撞"]
    PhysLayer --> Trajectory["运动轨迹"]
    Fizzy --> AutoBake
    AutoBake --> PhysLayer
    PhysLayer --> ForceField["力场（推动、下落）"]
    ForceField --> ConvexHole["凸孔（精准碰撞）"]
    ConvexHole --> PhysLayer
    PhysLayer --> RealTime["实时播放（无需Pi）"]
    RealTime --> Bake["可烘焙至动画序列"]
```

## 模块化控制器与直接网格控制
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    ModCtrl["模块化控制器系统"] --> EmptySlot["显示空插槽提示"]
    EmptySlot --> HideResolved["隐藏已解决插槽"]
    ModCtrl --> ShiftB["Shift + B 切换骨骼可见性"]
    ModCtrl --> DirectMesh["直接网格控制 (DMC)"]
    DirectMesh --> WeightPaint["权重绘制 & 遮罩"]
    WeightPaint --> SoftSelect["软选择功能"]
    DirectMesh --> MultiPoly["多层多边形组（FK/IK 切换）"]
    MultiPoly --> HierBinding["层级绑定（分层控制）"]
    HierBinding --> UI["UI 快捷键与快速菜单"]
    UI --> ShiftB
```
